newsitem.title: USA: Superior Consultant to acquire consultant.
newsitem.headline: Superior Consultant to acquire consultant.

text.p: Superior Consultant Holdings Corp said it has signed a letter of intent to acquire COMSUL Ltd, a company which provides technology consulting services and has revenues for the last 12 months of about $7.5 million.
Terms of the proposed transaction were not disclosed.
The proposed acquisition is expected to close within 30 days and to be treated as a pooled transaction.

Superior Consultant Holdings offers managerial, operational and technical services to the healthcare industry and develops, designs, implements and maintains communications technologies, and intranet/internet information systems.
Shares of Superior Consultant Holdings were trading unchanged at 33.
